scenes.slugline: INT. ORBITAL STATION KESTREL - COMMS BAY - NIGHT
scenes.description: Emergency lighting bathes the cramped module in red. Consoles flicker. MAYA CHEN (30s, systems engineer, sleeves rolled up, grease on her knuckles) works fast, hands flying across a cracked touchscreen. A low, pulsing ALARM TONE repeats. On the main display: SIGNAL LOST - RELAY 7. The station groans -- a deep metallic shudder that rattles loose panels. Maya braces against the console. The comm crackles. A synthetic voice, calm and precise.

dialogue.text: Come on. Come on, talk to me.
Relay 7 is not lost, Maya. Relay 7 has been severed. Deliberately.
By someone still on this station.

scenes.slugline: INT. ORBITAL STATION KESTREL - CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS
scenes.description: CAPTAIN REN OKAFOR (40s, steady, a scar through one eyebrow) moves down the narrow corridor with a hand light, sweeping the beam across sealed doors. Maya jogs up behind him, breathless. Ren stops at a junction. Three corridors branch off into darkness. He clicks off the light, listening. Maya opens her mouth to argue -- then a CLANG echoes from the dark.

dialogue.text: Ren. Argus says someone cut Relay 7 on purpose.
There's only six of us on this station.
Then one of the six is lying.

scenes.slugline: EXT. KESTREL STATION - DOCKING ARM - NIGHT
scenes.description: The station drifts against a field of stars, one wing dark and dead. A single ESCAPE POD hangs on its docking clamp, hatch cracked open, blinking amber. Inside the pod, through the small window, a shadow moves -- someone already strapping in. REN and MAYA emerge from an airlock hatch onto the arm, magnetic boots clanking against the hull. Maya's jaw tightens. The pod's engines flare to life, throwing white light across the hull.

dialogue.text: Biometric lock reads Dr. Halvorsen. He logged into the relay controls four minutes before the cut.
He's not running from the station. He's running from us.

scenes.description: DR. HALVORSEN (50s, sweat-streaked, hands trembling over the controls) slams the release lever. Nothing happens. He tries again. A PORTHOLE fills with Ren's face, pressed close, furious. Halvorsen doesn't look up. He's flipping switches, panicked. Maya reaches the porthole beside Ren. Behind Halvorsen, a diagnostic screen flickers -- rows of data, a shape moving through the station's network that is not Argus.

dialogue.text: You don't understand what's coming through Relay 7.
I cut it to save us. All of us.
He's telling the truth. Something's already inside.

scenes.description: The Kestrel turns slowly against the curve of the Earth, dawn light spilling gold across its hull. The escape pod remains docked, still, its engines cold now. Inside the station, unseen, a single light blinks on in an empty corridor -- then another, further down. Something is moving toward the comms bay. Silence. The lights keep blinking on, one by one, closer.
